descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_update: Per-frame sound update: ranks audible emitters by priority, keeps or frees voices, assigns free voices and advances all emitters.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_create_emitter: Allocates and constructs a sound emitter and appends it to the manager's emitter list, growing the list when full.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_set_float: Sets the emitter volume (properties 1 and 11) scaled by the master volume; reports failure for other properties.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_attach_801e117c: Attaches a sample to an emitter and derives its randomised rate and volume from the sample, scaled by master volume.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_update_attenuation: Computes the emitter's distance attenuation from the listener and returns 0 when it is in range and audible, else 1.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_list_insert: Inserts an emitter into the 32-slot priority list before the first entry with a higher priority value, shifting the rest.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_set_voice_parameter: Passes a numbered float parameter to every allocated voice in the manager.
